invariants.rule: endpoint_time <= confirmed_at <= available_at
execution_time >= available_at
unfinished object can emit candidate only, never confirmed signal
invalidated candidates remain stored with reason and revision
all boundary comparisons use integer minimum-tick units
floating epsilon is forbidden
inclusion merges are sequential and direction-aware
processed bar preserves all raw members and separate high/low source refs
fractal detection runs on processed bars, not raw bars with unresolved inclusion
top extreme is selected top-fractal high; bottom extreme is selected bottom-fractal low
a confirmed bi connects selected opposite fractals
endpoint fractal members are disjoint
at least one processed bar belongs to neither endpoint fractal
before reversal confirmation, higher same-type top or lower same-type bottom replaces earlier candidate
confirmed up-bi endpoint equals selected top-fractal extreme; confirmed down-bi endpoint equals selected bottom-fractal extreme
bi never acts as standard-center component
only transitions listed in state_machine.json are legal
segment has odd bi count and at least three bi
first three bi overlap
a pen break alone does not confirm segment completion
structural endpoint and range extreme are stored separately
segment endpoint may be non-extreme; this exception never applies to bi
standard center uses at least three consecutive completed same-level components
standard center component type is segment or sublevel_movement, never bi
ZD = max(first_three_component_lows) and ZG = min(first_three_component_highs)
center exists iff ZD <= ZG under closed intervals
after confirmation ZD and ZG are immutable
DD <= ZD <= ZG <= GG
nine-component extension emits higher-level center candidate
same completed movement at fixed level is exactly one of consolidation, uptrend, downtrend
trend has at least two ordered non-overlapping same-level centers
bar timeframe and structural level are distinct fields
standard trend divergence requires at least two same-level non-overlapping centers
final compared leg makes a new directional extreme
compared legs are selected structurally before indicator comparison
MACD, MA, BOLL, gap and Zn cannot create structural objects
consolidation divergence is not labeled standard B1 or S1
B2/S2 is first completed lower-level retest after B1/S1 counter-move
B2 below B1 is permitted and tagged weak_variant
B3 requires completed up departure and first completed down return
B3 first_return_low >= ZG; equality is accepted
S3 requires completed down departure and first completed up return
S3 first_return_high <= ZD; equality is accepted
first-return eligibility is consumed once per departure
BARDO is an unclassified live phase, not a fourth completed movement type
experimental_bi_overlap never mixes IDs, signals or PnL with standard center
no leverage is default and any override is explicit and separately approved
risk layer may reduce or block but never increase strategy target beyond configured cap
no code or report field may represent guaranteed profit
